paragraphs: I'm Muhammad Moiz Latif, a web developer based in Taxila, Pakistan, currently in my first semester of a Cyber Security degree. Alongside my studies, I completed a web development course and build modern, responsive websites for businesses and individuals around the world.

I chose web development partly because strong programming skills are essential in cyber security — building real websites keeps my coding sharp and lets me practice creating useful web tools. This background means I build every website with security, speed, and clean code in mind, not just good looks.

faq.question: How long does a website take?
faq.answer: A landing page takes about 5 days; a business website 10–14 days. Timelines are always confirmed before we start.

faq.question: Do I need to provide the text and images?
faq.answer: You can provide them, or I can help you prepare content for your pages.

faq.question: Can you redesign my existing website?
faq.answer: Yes, redesign and modernisation is one of my services.

faq.question: How do payments work?
faq.answer: Project terms, including payment schedule, are agreed clearly in writing before any work begins.

faq.question: Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?
faq.answer: Yes, most of my focus is on international clients. I communicate in English and work across time zones.

faq.question: What if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: Every package includes free post-launch support, and affordable maintenance is available after that.
